_doc: Cell-type vocabulary for the workshop: which obs columns carry the labels, and how named lineages map onto the Cell Ontology. Keeps biological definitions out of the prompts and the figure code.
label_column_note: Fine-grained MiraTyper call (Cell Ontology names). Produced in Step 0; also pre-baked in the crop obs.
immune_root_note: A cell is 'immune' iff its type is `leukocyte` or any ontology descendant of it.
membership_rule: A cell belongs to a lineage iff its label is the lineage's ontology root, or any descendant of that root in the Cell Ontology graph (assets/cell_ontology_graph.pkl). Use directed descendants (general -> specific).
draw_order_note: Resolves cells that match multiple sets (e.g. a cytotoxic CD8 cell is also a 'T cell'). Paint in this order; later entries win. 'Malignant' fills any non-immune cell with p_malignant >= threshold that no lineage claimed.
immune_legend_groups_note: Figure 1's immune legend rolls fine cell types up to these major lineages so sparse-but-fragmented lineages (e.g. CD8, split across 6 subtypes) still appear. First match wins, ordered specific->general; 'Other immune' = leukocyte catch-all. The image still colors each cell by its fine ontology hue; each legend swatch uses the group's most-common subtype color as a representative.
